text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines and software do tasks that people used to do, such as sorting data or answering customer questions. Companies also use productivity tools powered by AI to help workers finish their tasks faster and make fewer mistakes. In many jobs, humans and AI now work together. For example, doctors use AI to study medical images, but they still make the final decisions. This collaboration can improve results. However, some jobs may disappear or change, so workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive in the modern job market.
